overview.title: Field Biophysical Telemetry & Spatial Context
overview.subtitle: Live integration of NASA POWER climatology and ISRIC SoilGrids v2.0 top-30cm soil properties for any global coordinate.
overview.mapHint: Click anywhere on the global map or choose a benchmark site to inspect agroecological zoning and regional cultivar localization.

rotation.title: 4-Season Adaptive Crop Rotation Engine
rotation.subtitle: Evaluates combinatorial crop sequences across seasonal rainfall windows, root moisture (GWETROOT), AWC, and nitrogen cycling.
rotation.pathwayADesc: Prioritizes organic matter restoration (SOC), biological nitrogen fixation via legumes/cover crops, and pest-cycle breaking.
rotation.pathwayBDesc: Minimizes water deficit risk during dry-season windows by enforcing deep-rooted drought-tolerant species in low-moisture months.
rotation.pathwayCDesc: Maximizes economic return index using high-value market crops while maintaining soil AWC and organic carbon safety bounds.

crops.title: Global Crop Species & Regional Cultivar Library
crops.subtitle: Species taxonomy is strictly separated from regionally verified cultivars to prevent invalid varietal transfer across borders.

soil.title: Soil Bio-Battery & Hydraulic Retention Analysis
soil.subtitle: Pedotransfer modeling converting ISRIC SoilGrids sand/silt/clay and SOC into root-zone Available Water Capacity (AWC).

water.title: Monthly Agroclimatic Water Balance (FAO-56)
water.subtitle: Computes daily reference evapotranspiration (ET0) from NASA POWER temperature and solar irradiance against PRECTOTCORR rainfall.

provenance.title: Data Provenance, Sources & Scientific Boundaries
provenance.subtitle: Transparent reporting of live API telemetry versus regional fallback models and non-integrated reference datasets.

advisor.title: TerraShaft Precision Agronomy Advisor
advisor.subtitle: Telemetry-grounded Q&A combining active site zoning, localized cultivars, and documented agronomy references.
advisor.placeholder: Ask about drought mitigation, soil pH management, or localized crop rotation...

actionSheet.title: Field Action Sheet & Seasonal Execution Plan
actionSheet.subtitle: Printable farmer and extension summary reflecting active coordinates, agroecological zone, and localized cultivars.

settings.title: Workspace Settings & Language Configuration
settings.subtitle: Configure display language, high-contrast outdoor mode, and Gemini API key for field consultations.
settings.languageCardDesc: Switching between English and Indonesian updates interface labels only. Telemetry values, agroecological zoning, and rotation math remain identical.
